tasks.description: Verify pnpm workspace and mono-repo structure
steps: 1. Verify pnpm-workspace.yaml exists with packages/* configuration
2. Verify root package.json has all required scripts (build, build:cli, build:mcp, dev, dev:cli, dev:mcp, lint, clean, changeset, version, publish)
3. Verify packages/cli and packages/mcp exist with proper package.json
4. Verify pnpm install runs without errors
5. VERIFY: pnpm install succeeds with exit code 0
6. VERIFY: pnpm build succeeds with exit code 0

tasks.description: Verify CLI package is working with all parameters
steps: 1. Verify CLI supports: --ulw, --model, --agent, --max-iterations, --extend, --config, --spec, --desc, --package-manager, --git-branch
2. Verify auto-code-bot.json config file is properly read
3. Verify CLI can execute on a test project
4. VERIFY: pnpm build:cli succeeds with exit code 0
5. VERIFY: CLI --help shows all expected parameters

tasks.description: Implement MCP service entry point and stdio transport
steps: 1. Create packages/mcp/src/index.ts with MCP server entry point
2. Implement stdio transport for MCP communication
3. Export executable entry from packages/mcp/src/index.ts
4. Configure build script to output to dist/index.js
5. VERIFY: pnpm build:mcp succeeds with exit code 0
6. VERIFY: Can start MCP service via command+args without immediate exit
1. Implement Tool: auto_dev_status(project_dir) - returns phase, passing/total, category stats, recent progress summary
2. Implement Resource: project://{project_dir}/task.json - read-only task.json content
3. Implement Resource: project://{project_dir}/progress.txt - read-only progress.txt content
4. Implement Resource: project://{project_dir}/app_spec.md - read-only app_spec.md content
5. Reuse CLI or core phase detection and task parsing logic
6. VERIFY: pnpm build:mcp succeeds with exit code 0
7. VERIFY: In MCP client, calling auto_dev_status returns correct response matching target project files

tasks.description: Implement auto_dev_run_one_task Tool (single execution of next pending task)
steps: 1. Extract reusable function from agent for 'execute only next pending task' (if not already exists)
2. Implement Tool: auto_dev_run_one_task(project_dir, options?) - spawns single opencode session to complete one task
3. Support optional parameters: model, ulw, etc. (aligned with CLI)
4. Run non-blocking or return 'started, check status later' for long operations
5. VERIFY: pnpm build:mcp succeeds with exit code 0
6. VERIFY: In MCP client, calling auto_dev_run_one_task updates target project task.json (passes:false -> passes:true)

tasks.description: Implement auto_dev_start Tool (non-blocking full automation loop)
steps: 1. Implement Tool: auto_dev_start(project_dir, options?) - non-blocking start of full loop (equivalent to CLI auto-code-bot <dir> --ulw)
2. Support optional parameters: model, ulw, maxIterations, extend, etc.
3. Return message 'Started, poll auto_dev_status for progress'
4. Run in background process/subprocess to avoid blocking MCP connection
5. VERIFY: pnpm build:mcp succeeds with exit code 0
6. VERIFY: After calling auto_dev_start, auto_dev_status reflects in-progress or completed status

tasks.description: Verify multi-package build and publish workflow with changesets
steps: 1. Verify changesets configuration in package.json
2. Verify CHANGESETS.md exists (or .changeset/config.json)
3. Verify build:cli and build:mcp work independently
4. Test changeset workflow: pnpm changeset -> pnpm changeset version -> pnpm changeset publish
5. VERIFY: pnpm build succeeds with exit code 0
6. VERIFY: pnpm build:cli succeeds with exit code 0
7. VERIFY: pnpm build:mcp succeeds with exit code 0
